approval_source.question_set: E04 remaining policy questions, penalties and withdrawals

decisions.question: D09-Q04
decisions.rule: A validator's first duplicate vote deducts a fixed share from all stake bonded to it at that height, self-bond and delegators alike. The validator is removed for good and its consensus key is never reused; later evidence against it adds nothing. Light-client attacks are recorded only. There is no downtime penalty.

decisions.question: D09-Q05
decisions.rule: An unbond can be withdrawn once both evidence age limits plus their margins have passed and no penalty on it is unsettled, from genesis.

decisions.question: D09-Q04, D09-Q05 (locked stake)
decisions.rule: Bonded vesting-locked DGT carries the same risk as any stake. A penalty comes off the amount still locked, and the vesting dates stay the same.

decisions.question: D09-Q04 (penalty reserve)
decisions.rule: Penalized DGT moves to a penalty escrow that nothing can spend. The DGT total stays fixed.

unset: Evidence age limits and processing margins (D09-Q03, E05)
